description: International transfers from Iranian banks to most destinations are unavailable, so value moves through sarafi (exchange house) and hawala networks.
Informal transfer carries a commission plus an exchange spread, commonly estimated at 2-8% of the amount, with no recourse if the counterparty fails.
energy_note: Life savings moved on trust with no legal remedy.
notes: Percentage band is an estimate from general reporting. Layer-5 target: sarafi rate data.

description: Immigration proof-of-funds rules require a traceable origin and often six months of statements. Funds arriving by hawala have no paper trail, so money that exists cannot be shown to exist.
energy_note: Solvent on paper at home, destitute on paper abroad.

description: A large cash or informal-origin deposit by an Iranian national triggers AML review at the receiving bank - the same de-risking reflex that closes accounts.

aspect: Property that cannot be sold out
description: A family home in Tehran may be worth a deposit on a house abroad, but the proceeds cannot be moved. Wealth is effectively trapped inside the border.

aspect: EXAMPLE - six months of statements you cannot produce
description: Proof-of-funds rules typically want six months of statements showing a traceable origin. Money moved by sarafi arrives as a lump with no history, which reads to a visa officer exactly like money laundering.
energy_note: The only way to move it is the way that makes it unusable.

description: Canadian Express Entry requires proof of settlement funds scaled to family size. An applicant with a house in Tehran and no transferable currency fails a means test he would pass on any honest measure of wealth.

aspect: SCENARIO - the proof of funds he cannot prove
description: Omid's family sells a Tehran apartment for the equivalent of USD 96,000. The money reaches Toronto in four transfers from three different names over five weeks, via a sarafi, at a 4.5% spread. IRCC asks for six months of statements showing the source. He has a lump sum from strangers and no document that explains it.
